properties.name: civictrace:sbom-generator
properties.value: cyclonedx-py 7.5.0 requirements requirements.lock --output-reproducible, then scripts/annotate_runtime_sbom.py (deterministic; re-running reproduces these bytes)

properties.name: civictrace:sbom-annotation
properties.value: CT-QC-042 annotated the 17 licenses of the distributions introduced by the Firestore transport adapter; CT-QC-045 completed the remaining 17 from each package's own declared license for the exact pinned version (installed distribution metadata, cross-checked against the pypi.org JSON API and the license text shipped in <dist>-<ver>.dist-info/licenses/). All 34 runtime components now carry a declared SPDX license id. Attribution obligations are collected in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md; the inventory and coherence check is scripts/check_sbom_coherence.py.

properties.name: civictrace:compatibility
properties.value: CT-QC-042 adds google-cloud-firestore 2.34.1 (Apache-2.0) and its 16 transitive distributions so civictrace/spend_firestore_client.py can implement the production accounting transport. The pinned resolution changes no pre-existing pin (17 -> 34 runtime distributions, all hash-pinned in requirements.lock). Compatibility: Python 3.13 with cp313 wheels for grpcio 1.85.0, cryptography 50.0.2, cffi 2.1.1 and protobuf 7.36.2; the SDK requires google-api-core[grpc]>=2.28.0, google-auth>=2.14.1, google-cloud-core>=2.0.0, grpcio>=1.59.0, proto-plus>=1.26.1 and protobuf>=6.33.5, all satisfied by the locked versions. The SDK is imported only by the firestore backend; a sqlite deployment does not load it. Licenses: Apache-2.0 (Google and grpc packages, opentelemetry-api, requests), Apache-2.0 OR BSD-3-Clause (cryptography), BSD-3-Clause (protobuf, pycparser, click, httpcore, httpx, idna, starlette, uvicorn), BSD-2-Clause (pyasn1, pyasn1-modules), MIT-0 (cffi), MIT (annotated-doc, annotated-types, anyio, charset-normalizer, fastapi, h11, pydantic, pydantic-core, typing-inspection, urllib3), PSF-2.0 (typing-extensions). All are permissive except certifi (MPL-2.0, unmodified redistribution) and the MPL-2.0 scoped roots.pem bundled inside grpcio; both are recorded in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
